reference.title: Build parameters
reference.shortdesc: Parameters are passed on the command line as -Dname=value, or in a DITA-OT project file.

row.entry: Parameter
Values
Purpose
neutral (default), istanduk, nhs, official

Branding mode. The iStandUK theme layers brand colours and the logo on top of neutral; nhs applies the NHS Design System palette and header, and official the full GOV.UK crown branding — each for the entitled organisation only. See .
text
The name in the masthead and footer. Defaults to the map title, or a bookmap's main book title.
text
Shows a GOV.UK phase banner above the content with this tag, for example alpha or beta. Empty (default) shows no banner. Works in every branding mode.
text
Feedback link shown in the phase banner (used only when govuk.phase is set). Empty shows the banner text without a link.
text
Target of the masthead home link. Empty (default) links to the generated site's own home page.
text
Path to a favicon (.ico, .png or .svg) to copy into the output and link from every page. Empty ships no favicon.
text
Extra footer links as a ;-separated list of label|url pairs, for example Privacy|https://…/privacy;Contact|https://…/contact.
text
auto (default), start, annotated, list, grid, grouped, accordion
Landing-page layout. auto chooses from the map's shape; see .
1–9; default 2
How many levels of the map the landing page shows (grid, grouped, accordion, and start layouts): 1 lists top-level entries only, 2 adds their children, higher values nest deeper.
auto (default), yes, no
Site search; see .
path
Location of the Pagefind executable when it is not on the PATH.
default (default), reference, or a JSON object

How search results are scored. reference ranks exact-title pages first (raw term counts, no long-page penalty), which suits dictionaries, catalogues and standards; a JSON object passes Pagefind ranking options through unchanged. See .
yes (default), no
Inline local SVG diagrams as native SVG so links inside them work; no keeps the image rendering.
Further parameters — phase banner, footer links, favicon — arrive with their features; each is listed here when it lands.
